name: almagest
description: One Obsidian vault for the wiki, the sessions, and the changes of your work, shared by Claude Code and Codex.

args: h=$ALMAGEST_HOME; [ -n "$h" ] || h=$HOME/.almagest; for b in "$ALMAGEST_BIN" "$h/bin/almagest" "$HOME/go/bin/almagest"; do if [ -n "$b" ] && [ -x "$b" ]; then exec "$b" mcp; fi; done; echo 'almagest: the almagest binary is not installed.' >&2; echo 'Install it with: make install (in an almagest checkout), or set ALMAGEST_BIN to its path.' >&2; exit 1

interface.shortDescription: One vault for the wiki, the sessions, and the changes.
interface.longDescription: Keep what you know and what your agents do in one Obsidian vault, with a reviewed change for every wiki edit and a session document for every agent session.
defaultPrompt: Use the almagest skill to orient me in this vault.
